FiscalOverhaul.Options.Title: Fiscal Overhaul
FiscalOverhaul.Options.Desc.EnableSimula: The master switch for every feature that changes how the game itself plays: demand, happiness, service efficiency and upkeep, and the taxes buildings pay (density taxes, district tax rates, district service budgets). Off: all of them run exactly as vanilla, whatever their own switches say; your settings are kept. The charts and histories are not affected.
FiscalOverhaul.Options.Desc.EnableBudget: Replaces the bar chart in Economy > Budget with a line chart of each revenue and expense over time. Off: the Budget tab is the vanilla one.
FiscalOverhaul.Options.Desc.EnableDensit: A beta feature, off by default. Adds a density tax: its own rate per zone and density (set in Economy > Taxation, −5% to +10%), paid on top of income tax; income only, demand and happiness are unchanged. Off: no density tax is charged and the Taxation tab hides the density rows; your rates are kept for when you switch it back on.
FiscalOverhaul.Options.Desc.EnableDistri: Records each district's share of taxes, fees, subsidies and service upkeep 32 times a month, kept in the save, for the per-district budget view. Needs the budget chart on. Off: nothing new is recorded; what was recorded is kept.

A beta feature, off by default. Lets each district (and Outside Districts) run a service at its own budget %, from 50% to 150%, changing that district's service buildings' efficiency and upkeep; districts without one follow the city slider. Needs Simulation changes on. Off: every building follows the city slider; the district budgets stay in the save.
FiscalOverhaul.Options.Desc.ResetDistric: Clears every district's service budget in the city you have loaded, so all districts follow the city sliders again.
FiscalOverhaul.Options.Warning.ResetDist: Clear every district service budget in this city?
FiscalOverhaul.Options.Desc.RunOnUnteste: The mod's tax charging is checked against specific game versions. On any other version taxes stay vanilla and the Taxation tab says so. On: run it anyway (at your own risk). It still stays off if the game's code no longer matches.
FiscalOverhaul.Options.Desc.ResetDensity: Sets the loaded city's density tax rates (set in Economy > Taxation, the city's and every district's) and the starting rates for new cities back to 0, so buildings pay no density tax.
FiscalOverhaul.Options.Warning.ResetDens: Reset all density tax rates to 0?
FiscalOverhaul.UI.ChartEmpty: Tick a row on the left to plot it.
FiscalOverhaul.UI.TaxEngineUntestedVersi: Fiscal Overhaul hasn't been tested with this game version, so taxes are the game's own and tax adjustments are not charged. Options > Fiscal Overhaul > Run on untested game version turns them on anyway.
Fiscal Overhaul is charging taxes on a game version it hasn't been tested with (Options > Run on untested game version).
FiscalOverhaul.UI.TaxEngineIncompatible: Fiscal Overhaul can't charge taxes on this game version (or another mod already does), so taxes are the game's own and tax adjustments are not charged.
